name: contact-form
title: Contact Form
description: A two-tile contact form with a topic picker, a character count, optional consent, and an info tile with the response time.

props.name: consent
props.description: Consent line (may hold a privacy link). The checkbox only appears when this is passed.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called with the values; the section waits for it. Reject to show the error state.

props.name: labels
props.type: { name?: string; email?: string; topic?: string; message?: string; send?: string; sending?: string; sentTitle?: string; sentText?: string; another?: string; errorText?: string; retry?: string; …

a11y.text: A section named by its h2 with a form tile and an aside named by its h3 (default "Other ways to reach us") holding email, phone and address in a description list. Name, email and message have real labels; aria-invalid and aria-describedby point to the error; the message count ("{n} / 800", or "{n} over" past the limit) is also in its aria-describedby.

Sending, sent and error states are announced through a role="status" region. With more than one topic, the topic is Pills from chart-kit when the form tile is at least 26rem wide and a native select when narrower, both named by "Topic". Consent is a checkbox in a label that only shows when consent is passed.

On an invalid submit focus moves to the first invalid field. The send button uses aria-disabled while sending so it keeps focus. After sent, focus moves to the confirmation heading, and "Write another" moves it back to the name field.
The press feedback on the send button is dropped under reduced motion.
